title: Sleepy otter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sleepy otter, floating on back, whole subject -->
  <!-- body / belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#8a5a3b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='21' ry='15' fill='#c98f5e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#9a6a45'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='27' r='5.5' fill='#7d5233'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='27' r='5.5' fill='#7d5233'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='27' r='2.8' fill='#b57d52'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='27' r='2.8' fill='#b57d52'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#e0b58a'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M38 35 q4 3.5 8 0' stroke='#4a3222' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 35 q4 3.5 8 0' stroke='#4a3222' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3b2a1e'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 47 q4 3 8 0' stroke='#6b4a30' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='42' r='3' fill='#e8907a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='42' r='3' fill='#e8907a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- front paws folded on belly -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='60' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#7d5233'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='60' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#7d5233'/>
  <!-- back paws tucked up -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='82' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#7d5233'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='82' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#7d5233'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='12' ry='5' fill='#8a5a3b'/>
  <!-- little zzz -->
  <path d='M74 20 h7 l-7 6 h7' stroke='#9fd4ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M82 12 h5 l-5 4 h5' stroke='#9fd4ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
